rules.scope: All private employers; amendments and written notices of changed contract elements (OR 330b para. 2).
rules.trigger_text: After end of employment (EDÖB framing).
rules.guidance: Same as employment contract: no explicit statutory period; EDÖB guidance 10 years (reference data) / 5 years (wage data).
rules.max_guidance: As for employment contract.
rules.source: OR Art. 330b para. 2, Art. 127, Art. 128 no. 3; EDÖB FAQ
rules.verification: OR 330b read on Fedlex filestore; retention derived from EDÖB FAQ.
rules.limitations: Retention is guidance-derived.

rules.scope: All private employers. Contract data needed to issue a reference (OR 330a) and to defend contract/wage claims.
rules.trigger_text: EDÖB frames retention after the end of employment; limitation runs from the claim falling due (OR 130).
rules.guidance: No explicit statutory retention period. EDÖB guidance: 10 years for personal data needed to issue the reference (OR 330a i.V.m. 127, ten-year general limitation), 5 years for data needed for wage payment. If the contract is an accounting voucher, OR 958f 10 years.
rules.max_guidance: EDÖB: after employment ends only necessary data may be kept, usually 5 to 10 years depending on law; otherwise destroy once retention is no longer necessary.
rules.source: OR Art. 330a, Art. 127; EDÖB FAQ Datenschutz
rules.verification: EDÖB FAQ fetched; OR 127 ('Mit Ablauf von zehn Jahren verjähren alle Forderungen, für die das Bundeszivilrecht nicht etwas anderes bestimmt.') and OR 330a read on Fedlex filestore.
rules.limitations: Guidance, not statute. Keep the period configurable; suggest 10 years after end of employment as default.

rules.scope: Copies of identity documents of employees.
rules.trigger_text: Not applicable (no statutory period).
rules.guidance: No statutory retention period found. AHVG Art. 51 para. 3 requires checking AHV registration data against official ID papers, but no duty to keep a copy was found. Under OR 328b / DSG Art. 6 a copy may only be kept if needed for the contract and must be destroyed once not needed.
rules.max_guidance: DSG Art. 6 para. 4: destroy or anonymise as soon as no longer necessary. EDÖB employment pages fetched do not address ID copies specifically.
rules.source: AHVG Art. 51 para. 3; OR Art. 328b; DSG Art. 6 para. 3-4
rules.verification: AHVG and DSG read on Fedlex filestore; EDÖB FAQ and phases page fetched (no specific statement on ID copies). Absence of a period is a negative finding, not exhaustive.
rules.limitations: Not exhaustive: sector rules (e.g. AML, security clearance) not researched. Recommend recording 'checked on / by' instead of storing the copy.

rules.scope: Application documents of rejected applicants (no hiring).
rules.trigger_text: From notification of the rejection.
rules.guidance: Maximum guidance: up to three months after communicating the rejection (to defend discrimination claims under GlG Art. 8 para. 2 with Art. 5 para. 2); a few more weeks may be justified if a court serves a claim late.
rules.max_guidance: Up to 3 months after rejection (EDÖB).
rules.source: EDÖB FAQ Datenschutz; GlG Art. 8 para. 2 i.V.m. Art. 5 para. 2 (cited by EDÖB, not fetched)
rules.verification: Fetched EDÖB FAQ page (WebFetch).
rules.limitations: GlG text itself not fetched. Only relevant if applicants are stored in the module.

rules.scope: Undertakings subject to bookkeeping duty (OR Art. 957: legal entities; sole proprietorships/partnerships with turnover >= CHF 500 000 full; smaller ones simplified bookkeeping). Payroll journals/wage accounting are business books and accounting vouchers.
rules.trigger_text: Period begins with the end of the business year (Ablauf des Geschäftsjahres).
rules.guidance: Business books and accounting vouchers (Buchungsbelege) kept for ten years.
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum. DSG Art. 6 para. 4: personal data destroyed or anonymised once no longer needed for the purpose; EDÖB: retention set per data category, typically 5 to 10 years depending on the law.
rules.verification: Read consolidated OR text from the official Fedlex filestore (consolidation 2026-10-01, DE); footnote shows Art. 958f wording in force since 1 Jan 2023.
rules.limitations: Classifying a given payroll document as a Buchungsbeleg is an accounting judgement. Form of storage governed by OR 958f para. 3 and GeBüV Art. 9-10 (see CH-REC-GEBUEV-001).

rules.scope: Personal data needed for the duty to pay wages (e.g. working time, sick leave, holidays), all private employers (EDÖB guidance based on limitation of wage claims).
rules.trigger_text: Limitation starts with the claim falling due (OR Art. 130 para. 1: 'Die Verjährung beginnt mit der Fälligkeit der Forderung').
rules.guidance: EDÖB: retention period of 5 years for personal data necessary for the wage payment duty (OR 322 i.V.m. 128: wage claims become time-barred after five years).
rules.max_guidance: EDÖB: 'Das DSG selbst sieht keine Aufbewahrungsfrist vor'; retention to be set per data category; delete when no longer necessary.
rules.source: OR Art. 128 no. 3 (five-year limitation for claims from the employment relationship of employees); EDÖB FAQ Datenschutz
rules.verification: Fetched EDÖB FAQ page (WebFetch); OR Art. 128 text read on Fedlex filestore: 'Mit Ablauf von fünf Jahren verjähren die Forderungen: ... 3. ... aus dem Arbeitsverhältnis von Arbeitnehmern.'
rules.limitations: Authority guidance derived from limitation periods, not a statutory retention duty. Bookkeeping (10 y) usually overrides for payroll vouchers.

rules.scope: Employer's copy of the written pay statement (OR 323b) where it forms part of the payroll accounting vouchers of a bookkeeping-obliged undertaking.
rules.trigger_text: OR 958f: from end of the business year.
rules.guidance: Ten years as accounting voucher (OR 958f); EDÖB additionally names 5 years for personal data needed for the duty to pay wages (OR 322 with 128).
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum; DSG Art. 6 para. 4 storage limitation once legal reasons lapse.
rules.source: OR Art. 958f para. 1 (as accounting voucher); OR Art. 323b para. 1 (duty to hand over written statement); EDÖB FAQ (OR 322 i.V.m. 128)
rules.verification: Statutory text verified on Fedlex filestore; treating a payslip copy as Buchungsbeleg is an interpretation, not stated in the text.
rules.limitations: OR does not literally require the employer to keep a copy of the payslip; the duty arises through accounting rules. Confirm with a fiduciary.

rules.scope: All private employers: personnel dossier.
rules.trigger_text: When the employment ends.
rules.guidance: EDÖB: after employment ends only necessary data may be kept; usually 5 to 10 years depending on what the law requires; during employment the file must be sorted out regularly.
rules.max_guidance: EDÖB: 'In allen anderen Fällen müssen die Daten vernichtet werden, sobald ihre Aufbewahrung nicht mehr erforderlich ist.' Earlier performance reviews to be removed and destroyed regularly.
rules.source: OR Art. 328b; DSG Art. 6 para. 4; EDÖB guidance 'Verschiedene Phasen des Arbeitsverhältnisses'
rules.verification: Fetched EDÖB page (WebFetch).
rules.limitations: Range, not a single number; per-category periods come from the rules above.

rules.scope: All employers paying AHV/IV/EO contributions: wage records needed for settlement and employer audits.
rules.trigger_text: AHVG Art. 16: 'innert fünf Jahren nach Ablauf des Kalenderjahres, für welches sie geschuldet sind'.
rules.guidance: No explicit period in AHVV. Employers must record wages continuously as far as needed for settlement and the employer audit; the audit covers the non-time-barred contribution period, and contributions not claimed within five years after the end of the calendar year are time-barred (AHVG Art. 16 para. 1). Practical minimum therefore 5 years after the end of the calendar year; bookkeeping (OR 958f, 10 years) usually applies anyway.
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum; DSG storage limitation.
rules.source: AHVV (SR 831.101) Art. 143 para. 2; Art. 163 para. 2; AHVG (SR 831.10) Art. 16 para. 1
rules.verification: Read AHVV and AHVG consolidations (2026-01-01) on Fedlex filestore; AHVV Art. 163 para. 2: 'Gegenstand der Kontrolle ist die unverjährte Beitragsperiode.' The 5-year figure is derived, not an explicit retention period.
rules.limitations: Longer limitation applies where a claim derives from a criminal act (AHVG 16 para. 1). ATSG Art. 46 (record keeping) binds the insurer, not the employer. BVG/UVG/KTG/FAK record rules not researched.

rules.scope: Employers that are legal entities or self-employed natural persons (direct federal tax), incl. records on source tax withheld; source-tax debtor must give the tax authority insight into all documents (DBG 88 para. 1 c).
rules.trigger_text: DBG 126 para. 3 states no start event; in practice aligned with OR 958f (end of business year). Not stated in the fetched text.
rules.guidance: Business books, statements and other vouchers connected with the activity kept for ten years.
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum; DSG storage limitation after expiry. Cantonal tax laws may add rules (not researched).
rules.source: DBG (SR 642.11) Art. 126 para. 3; Art. 88 para. 1 let. b-c
rules.verification: Read DBG consolidated text (2026-09-02) on Fedlex filestore. QStV (SR 642.118.2, consolidation 2025-01-10) contains no explicit retention period. Cantonal rules not checked.
rules.limitations: Start trigger not stated in DBG 126; cantonal source-tax law (26 cantons) may set additional record rules. Private households as employers are not covered by DBG 126 para. 3 wording.

rules.scope: All private employers: notice of termination, reference letters (Arbeitszeugnis) and related correspondence.
rules.trigger_text: After end of employment.
rules.guidance: No explicit statutory period. EDÖB: 10 years for data needed for the reference (OR 330a: employee may request a reference 'jederzeit'; OR 127 ten-year limitation).
rules.max_guidance: Destroy when no longer necessary (DSG Art. 6 para. 4; EDÖB).
rules.source: OR Art. 330a para. 1, Art. 127; EDÖB FAQ
rules.verification: OR read on Fedlex filestore; period from EDÖB FAQ guidance.
rules.limitations: Guidance-derived period.

rules.scope: Employers subject to the Labour Act (ArG): registers and documents incl. personal details, type of employment, entry/exit, daily and weekly working time, breaks etc. (ArGV 1 Art. 73 para. 1).
rules.trigger_text: After expiry of their validity (nach Ablauf ihrer Gültigkeit).
rules.guidance: Registers and other documents kept for at least five years after expiry of their validity.
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum; DSG Art. 6 para. 4. Note that for authorities ArGV 1 sets destruction 5 years after validity expiry (a different provision for official data).
rules.verification: Read ArGV 1 consolidated text (2024-09-01) on Fedlex filestore.
rules.limitations: 'Expiry of validity' is not defined; conservative reading: from end of the period the record relates to. Waiver (Art. 73a) and simplified recording (Art. 73b) depend on a GAV or agreement; senior managers and other ArG exemptions not researched.

rules.scope: Employers of foreign nationals: duty to verify work authorisation before start (AIG Art. 91 para. 1).
rules.trigger_text: Not applicable (no statutory period found).
rules.guidance: AIG Art. 91 requires verification (inspection of the permit or enquiry with the authorities), not keeping a copy. No statutory retention period found. Keeping evidence of the check (date, permit type, expiry) is advisable to show due diligence.
rules.max_guidance: DSG Art. 6 para. 4 storage limitation; keep only as long as needed to prove due diligence (e.g. limitation periods), then destroy.
rules.verification: AIG consolidated text (2026-11-01) read on Fedlex filestore. SEM directives (Weisungen AIG ch. 4.8.9) could not be fetched (HTTP 404), so SEM guidance on copies is not verified. VZAE not searched for a copy duty beyond Grenzgänger permit text.
rules.limitations: SEM guidance not verified.

rules.scope: Changes to essential terms (NachwG record of the change)
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year of the amendment
rules.guidance: Same as the employment contract: copy in Entgeltunterlagen (SGB IV § 28f) and AO § 147 6 years where tax-relevant.
rules.max_guidance: As DE-RET-CONTRACT-001.
rules.source: BVV § 8 Abs. 2 Nr. 6; SGB IV § 28f; AO § 147
rules.verification: derived from fetched BVV § 8 and AO § 147; NachwG § 3 (changes) not fetched
rules.limitations: NachwG § 3 wording on notifying changes not verified.

rules.scope: Employment contract and the written statement of essential terms (NachwG § 2)
rules.trigger_text: For AO: end of the calendar year in which the document was created; SGB IV: year following the last audit
rules.guidance: No labour-law retention period for the contract itself. A copy of the NachwG record belongs in the Entgeltunterlagen (BVV § 8 Abs. 2 Nr. 6) and so follows SGB IV § 28f; as a tax-relevant 'sonstige Unterlage' AO § 147 gives 6 years.
rules.max_guidance: Keep during employment; after the end, keep only for the longest applicable statutory/claim period, then delete (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e), BDSG § 26 Abs. 1: only as necessary for ending the employment).
rules.source: BVV § 8 Abs. 2 Nr. 6; SGB IV § 28f; AO § 147 Abs. 1 Nr. 5, Abs. 3
rules.verification: read BVV § 8, SGB IV § 28f, AO § 147 on gesetze-im-internet.de; period is derived, not stated for contracts as such
rules.limitations: Civil-law limitation periods for claims (BGB) were not fetched; local review needed.

rules.scope: Copies of the German identity card (Personalausweis)
rules.trigger_text: n/a
rules.guidance: No statutory retention period. Copying only with the holder's consent, marked permanently as a copy, not passed on to third parties.
rules.max_guidance: Store only if needed; otherwise record that the ID was checked. Delete when the purpose ends (GDPR Art. 5(1)(c),(e)).
rules.verification: read § 20 PAuswG on gesetze-im-internet.de
rules.limitations: Passports (PassG) not checked. Upload UI should require a consent flag and 'copy' marking.

rules.scope: Every employer with employees in Germany: the wage-tax account (Lohnkonto) per employee and calendar year
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year of the last wage payment entered; then six further calendar years
rules.guidance: until the end of the sixth calendar year following the last recorded wage payment
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum; delete after expiry under GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) unless a longer period (AO § 147 for booking vouchers, SGB IV § 28f) or a pending audit applies.
rules.verification: read current consolidated text on gesetze-im-internet.de (no in-force date shown on the single-norm page)
rules.limitations: LStDV § 4 (content of the Lohnkonto) was fetched and contains no retention period itself; the period is in EStG § 41. Helvetly stores imported results only; the Lohnkonto content requirements (ELStAM data, tax-free pay, withheld tax) are produced by the external payroll system.

rules.scope: Payroll documents that serve as booking vouchers (Buchungsbelege) for taxpayers with record-keeping duty
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year in which the booking voucher was created / the record was made
rules.guidance: 8 years for Buchungsbelege (10 years for books/records, 6 years for other tax-relevant documents); does not end while relevant to an open assessment period
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum; GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) after expiry.
rules.source: AO § 147 Abs. 1 Nr. 4, Abs. 3, Abs. 4; transition Art. 97 § 19a Abs. 2 EGAO
rules.verification: read § 147 AO on gesetze-im-internet.de (AO Stand: neugefasst Bek. v. 23.1.2025, zuletzt geändert Art. 6 G v. 22.10.2026); Art. 97 § 19a Abs. 2 EGAO: the version in force from 1 January 2025 applies to all documents whose period had not expired by 31 December 2024
rules.limitations: Banks, insurers and investment firms keep 10 years for booking vouchers (Art. 97 § 19a Abs. 3 EGAO). Whether a given payroll document is a Buchungsbeleg or a 'sonstige Unterlage' (6 years) depends on the bookkeeping; default the longer period.

rules.scope: Merchants (Kaufleute) under HGB: commercial books and booking vouchers
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year in which the booking voucher came into existence
rules.guidance: 10 years for books/annual accounts, 8 years for booking vouchers, 6 years for business letters
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum; GDPR Art. 5(1)(e).
rules.verification: read current text on gesetze-im-internet.de
rules.limitations: Applies only to Kaufleute; AO § 147 applies to all taxpayers with record duties.

rules.scope: Employer's copies of pay statements, as part of the Lohnkonto / Entgeltunterlagen / booking vouchers
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year of the pay period
rules.guidance: No payslip-specific period found; the employer copy is covered by EStG § 41 (6th calendar year after last pay entry), SGB IV § 28f (year after last audit) and, where a booking voucher, AO § 147 (8 years). Keep for the longest applicable.
rules.max_guidance: GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) after the longest applicable period.
rules.verification: derived from fetched EStG § 41, SGB IV § 28f, AO § 147; the payslip duty itself (GewO § 108) was not fetched
rules.limitations: Classification of the payslip as booking voucher vs. other record is a bookkeeping question; GewO § 108 not verified.

rules.scope: Unsuccessful applicants' documents
rules.trigger_text: Receipt of the rejection or withdrawal of the application
rules.guidance: No retention duty; AGG claims must be asserted in writing within 2 months of the rejection, so BfDI considers keeping application documents for at most 6 months admissible.
rules.max_guidance: BfDI: maximum six months, then return or destroy.
rules.source: AGG § 15 Abs. 4; GDPR Art. 5(1)(c),(e), Art. 17; BfDI FAQ Beschäftigtendatenschutz
rules.verification: read AGG § 15 on gesetze-im-internet.de ('innerhalb einer Frist von zwei Monaten schriftlich geltend gemacht werden'; 'mit dem Zugang der Ablehnung') and BfDI FAQ (no Stand date on page)
rules.limitations: BfDI is guidance, addressed mainly to federal bodies; Land DPAs may differ.

rules.scope: Every employer: pay records (Entgeltunterlagen) per employee, by calendar year, kept in Germany in German
rules.trigger_text: Date of the last completed DRV employer audit (§ 28p); period ends at the end of the following calendar year
rules.guidance: until the end of the calendar year following the last social security audit (§ 28p SGB IV)
rules.max_guidance: No fixed maximum; delete only after the audit-based period AND the tax periods (EStG § 41, AO § 147) have expired.
rules.verification: read § 28f SGB IV and §§ 8, 9 BVV on gesetze-im-internet.de
rules.limitations: Needs the date of the last DRV audit, which the user must enter. BVV § 8 Abs. 2 requires electronic copies of e.g. work permits, the NachwG record and MiLoG records in the Entgeltunterlagen; § 9 Abs. 5 BVV: data must be 'in der Aufbewahrungsfrist jederzeit verfügbar und unverzüglich lesbar' and paper originals kept until the audit is final. Exemption from electronic records on application possible only until 31 December 2026 (§ 8 Abs. 3 BVV).

rules.scope: Wage-tax withholding records (ELStAM data, withheld tax in the Lohnkonto)
rules.trigger_text: Last wage payment entered in the Lohnkonto
rules.guidance: until the end of the sixth calendar year following the last recorded wage payment (also applies to § 93c AO records)
rules.max_guidance: ELStAM may be used only for withholding wage and church tax (EStG § 39 Abs. 8); delete after expiry.
rules.verification: read current text on gesetze-im-internet.de
rules.limitations: Helvetly does not retrieve ELStAM; imported values are copies.

rules.scope: Notice of termination, termination agreements, final settlement
rules.trigger_text: End of employment, then the calendar-year triggers of the payroll rules
rules.guidance: No specific statutory retention period found. Payroll-relevant parts (final pay, severance) follow EStG § 41 / AO § 147 / SGB IV § 28f; the end date of employment is a mandatory Entgeltunterlagen entry (BVV § 8 Abs. 1).
rules.max_guidance: Delete when claims are time-barred and no statutory period applies (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e), BDSG § 26 Abs. 1).
rules.source: none specific; GDPR Art. 5(1)(e); BDSG § 26 Abs. 1
rules.verification: absence of a specific period is a finding from the fetched statutes only; KSchG/BGB limitation periods not fetched
rules.limitations: Claim and limitation periods need local legal review.

rules.scope: Records of working time beyond 8 hours per working day and the list of employees who consented to longer hours (§ 7 Abs. 7 ArbZG)
rules.trigger_text: Not stated in § 16 ArbZG; treat as from the date of the record
rules.guidance: at least two years
rules.max_guidance: No maximum stated; delete when no longer necessary (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e)), unless the record is also payroll-relevant (then EStG § 41 / AO § 147 / SGB IV § 28f).
rules.verification: read current text on gesetze-im-internet.de
rules.limitations: BAG 1 ABR 22/21 (13.09.2022): general duty to record working time under § 3 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 ArbSchG; no statutory retention period for those general records was found.

rules.scope: Mini-jobbers (§ 8 Abs. 1 SGB IV) and employees in sectors of § 2a SchwarzArbG: start, end and duration of daily working time (not private-household mini-jobs)
rules.trigger_text: beginnend ab dem für die Aufzeichnung maßgeblichen Zeitpunkt
rules.guidance: at least two years from the time relevant for the record; record within 7 calendar days
rules.max_guidance: No maximum stated; GDPR Art. 5(1)(e). BVV § 8 Abs. 2 also puts these records into the Entgeltunterlagen (SGB IV § 28f).
rules.verification: read current text on gesetze-im-internet.de
rules.limitations: Documents must be kept in Germany in German (Abs. 2).

rules.scope: Non-EEA employees: nationality and residence title in the Entgeltunterlagen; BA work permit / residence title copy kept electronically
rules.trigger_text: Last § 28p audit
rules.guidance: Part of the Entgeltunterlagen: until the end of the calendar year after the last DRV audit (SGB IV § 28f).
rules.max_guidance: Delete after the § 28f period; GDPR Art. 5(1)(e).
rules.source: BVV § 8 Abs. 1 Nr. 3, Abs. 2 Nr. 2; SGB IV § 28f
rules.verification: read BVV § 8 and SGB IV § 28f; the AufenthG employer copy duty (§ 4a) was not fetched
rules.limitations: AufenthG § 4a Abs. 5 (employer keeps copy for the duration of employment) not verified.

rules.scope: Changes to the Dienstzettel / contract
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year of the amendment
rules.guidance: Same as contract: no specific period; BAO 7 years where tax-relevant.
rules.max_guidance: As AT-RET-CONTRACT-001.
rules.verification: derived from fetched texts
rules.limitations: AVRAG § 2 Abs. 6 (notification of changes) not fetched.

rules.scope: Employment contract / Dienstzettel (AVRAG § 2)
rules.trigger_text: BAO: end of the calendar year to which the document relates
rules.guidance: No labour-law retention period found. Tax-relevant documents: 7 years (BAO § 132). For posted/hired workers the contract or Dienstzettel must be kept available on site for the duration of the posting (LSD-BG § 22).
rules.max_guidance: Keep during employment; afterwards only while claims/tax periods are open; then delete (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e)).
rules.verification: read AVRAG § 2 (in force 28.03.2024), BAO § 132, LSD-BG § 22 (in force 20.07.2022) on RIS
rules.limitations: ABGB § 1486 limitation of wage claims not fetched; local review.

rules.scope: Copies of passports / ID cards
rules.trigger_text: n/a
rules.guidance: No statutory retention period found. Store only if necessary; data minimisation and storage limitation apply.
rules.max_guidance: GDPR Art. 5(1)(e): kept no longer than necessary; prefer recording that identity was checked.
rules.verification: GDPR text read on EUR-Lex; absence of an Austrian rule not exhaustively checked
rules.limitations: No Austrian ID-copy statute researched.

rules.scope: All books, records and supporting documents relevant to taxes, including the Lohnkonto (§ 76 EStG 1988)
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year for which the entries were made / to which the documents relate (for a non-calendar fiscal year: end of the calendar year in which it ends)
rules.guidance: seven years; longer while relevant to pending tax proceedings
rules.max_guidance: No statutory maximum; GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) after expiry and after pending proceedings end.
rules.verification: read RIS consolidated text (in force since 13.01.1999, BGBl. I Nr. 28/1999); confirmed by usp.gv.at 'Aufbewahrungspflicht' (Letzte Aktualisierung 1. Januar 2025)
rules.limitations: § 76 EStG 1988 (in force 20.07.2024) states the Lohnkonto content but no retention period; applying BAO § 132 to the Lohnkonto is an inference (usp.gv.at does not state it for the Lohnkonto explicitly). Longer periods (12/22 years) exist for real-estate records, not relevant here.

rules.scope: Employer copies of Lohn-/Gehaltsabrechnungen
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year to which the payslip relates
rules.guidance: As tax-relevant Belege: seven years (BAO § 132).
rules.max_guidance: GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) after expiry.
rules.verification: BAO § 132 read on RIS; usp.gv.at confirms payslips are handed over with the pay ('Lohn- bzw. Gehaltsabrechnungen werden der Arbeitnehmerin/dem Arbeitnehmer mit dem Entgelt ausgehändigt'); classification as Beleg is inference
rules.limitations: No payslip-specific statutory period found.

rules.scope: Records relevant to the social insurance relationship (ÖGK inspection)
rules.trigger_text: ASVG § 68: from the due date of the contributions (or from the late report); BAO: end of calendar year
rules.guidance: No ASVG retention period found. ASVG § 42 requires showing all books, receipts and other records on request; contribution assessment is time-barred after 3 years from due date, 5 years if reports were missing or wrong (§ 68). The 7-year BAO period for the same payroll records covers this window.
rules.max_guidance: Keep at least while § 68 assessment is open (5 years worst case) and for BAO 7 years; then GDPR Art. 5(1)(e).
rules.verification: read ASVG § 42 (in force 01.01.2026, BGBl. I Nr. 77/2025) and § 68 (in force 01.08.2010) on RIS; no explicit retention period in ASVG
rules.limitations: Limitation period is not a retention duty; combined with BAO is a reasoned default.

rules.scope: Lohnkonto data (name, SV number, Alleinverdiener/Familienbonus Plus data, allowances) and Lohnzettel L16
rules.trigger_text: End of the calendar year for which entries were made
rules.guidance: seven years under BAO § 132 (Lohnkonto content per § 76 EStG 1988 contains no own period)
rules.max_guidance: GDPR Art. 5(1)(e); children's SV numbers/birth dates for Familienbonus Plus are only needed for the Lohnkonto.
rules.verification: read § 76 EStG 1988 (in force 20.07.2024, BGBl. I Nr. 113/2024) and BAO § 132 on RIS; period by combination
rules.limitations: Lohnkontenverordnung not fetched.

rules.scope: Termination letters, final settlement (Endabrechnung)
rules.trigger_text: End of employment; BAO from end of that calendar year
rules.guidance: No specific statutory period found; the final settlement is due on the day of leaving (usp.gv.at) and is a payroll record under BAO § 132 (7 years).
rules.max_guidance: GDPR Art. 5(1)(e) after claims and tax periods.
rules.verification: usp.gv.at (Letzte Aktualisierung 1. Januar 2026) and BAO § 132
rules.limitations: Claim deadlines (e.g. Kündigungsanfechtung under ArbVG, ABGB) not fetched.

rules.scope: Records of hours worked (AZG § 26); drivers; register of young workers
rules.trigger_text: With averaging (Durchrechnung) the period starts at the end of the averaging period; otherwise not stated
rules.guidance: one year (drivers: 24 months; register of young workers: 2 years); longer periods may follow from other law (e.g. BAO if used for payroll)
rules.max_guidance: If the records support payroll, BAO § 132 7 years; otherwise delete after the period (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e)).
rules.source: AZG § 26 (record duty); retention per usp.gv.at (statutory provision for the 1-year period not identified)
rules.verification: AZG § 26 Abs. 1 read on RIS (in force 01.09.2018; 'Aufzeichnungen über die geleisteten Arbeitsstunden zu führen', no period in the text fetched); period from official USP portal (Letzte Aktualisierung 16. Januar 2025)
rules.limitations: Exact statutory source of the one-year period not confirmed; AZG § 26 Abs. 9 suspends forfeiture periods when records are missing, so employers have an interest in longer retention.

rules.scope: Work/residence permits of non-EEA employees
rules.trigger_text: n/a
rules.guidance: No retention period verified (AuslBG not fetched). Storage limitation applies; BAO 7 years only if the document is tax-relevant.
rules.max_guidance: GDPR Art. 5(1)(e).
rules.verification: AuslBG not fetched
rules.limitations: Needs local review.

rules.scope: Avenants to employment contracts
rules.trigger_text: As for the contract.
rules.guidance: No specific provision found; treat like the contract (FR-RET-CONTRACT-001).
rules.max_guidance: CNIL: limit to the applicable limitation period after employment ends.
rules.source: Code civil art. 2224 (as cited by service-public for employment contracts)
rules.verification: Inferred from the contract row on service-public F10029.
rules.limitations: Inference, not a dedicated rule.

rules.scope: Employment contracts, wage/bonus/severance documents
rules.trigger_text: Service-public gives no explicit start; prescription periods run from knowledge of facts / notification of termination.
rules.guidance: Official business guide lists 5 years (C. civ. 2224). No Code du travail article fixing a retention period for the contract itself was found. Limitation for claims on performance: 2 years; on termination: 12 months (L1471-1); wage claims: 3 years (L3245-1).
rules.max_guidance: CNIL: keep during employment; after it ends, intermediate archive only if legally required or for evidence, 'dans la limite du délai de prescription/forclusion applicable'.
rules.source: Code civil art. 2224 (as cited by service-public); Code du travail art. L1471-1
rules.verification: Read entreprendre.service-public.gouv.fr F10029 (Vérifié le 01 juillet 2024); C. civ. 2224 itself not fetched; L1471-1 read on legifrance.
rules.limitations: Only the value '5 ans' was quoted verbatim by the fetch; the row label (contracts, wages, bonuses, severance, final pay statements, pensions) was paraphrased. Check the row wording on the page.

rules.scope: Copies of identity documents
rules.trigger_text: n/a
rules.guidance: No statutory retention period found. The CNIL 2026 HR retention referential has no entry for ID copies.
rules.max_guidance: CNIL: data about an employee is kept for the time they are in the organisation; collect an ID copy only if necessary (data minimisation), prefer recording that it was checked.
rules.verification: Read CNIL page (17 août 2023) and decoded CNIL HR retention referential PDF (publié 2 avril 2026, mis à jour 20 mai 2026); absence of a statutory period is a negative finding.
rules.limitations: Negative finding; sector rules may exist.

rules.scope: Registre unique du personnel (single staff register) entries
rules.trigger_text: Date of departure from the establishment.
rules.guidance: Entries kept five years from the date the employee or intern left the establishment.
rules.max_guidance: CNIL referential: obligation of 5 years after departure; delete afterwards.
rules.source: Code du travail art. R1221-26 (register required by L1221-13)
rules.verification: Read article on legifrance.gouv.fr (en vigueur depuis le 29 octobre 2015). L1221-13 itself was not fetched.

rules.scope: Documents needed to establish the base of, or audit, social contributions
rules.trigger_text: Date the documents were established or received.
rules.guidance: At least six years from the date the documents were drawn up or received.
rules.max_guidance: CNIL referential lists 6 years for elements needed to calculate contributions; then delete (GDPR art. 5(1)(e)).
rules.source: Code de la sécurité sociale art. L243-16
rules.verification: Read article on legifrance.gouv.fr (version shown as in force 15 Nov 2026).

rules.scope: Commerçants: accounting documents and supporting records (payroll journal entries when part of the accounts)
rules.trigger_text: entreprendre.service-public.gouv.fr: '10 ans à partir de la clôture de l'exercice'.
rules.guidance: Accounting documents and supporting records kept ten years; service-public: from the close of the financial year.
rules.max_guidance: Applies to accounting records, not to the HR file as a whole; keep only the accounting-relevant payroll data for 10 years.
rules.verification: Read article version dated 04/01/2003 on legifrance.gouv.fr; page did not confirm it is the current version, but service-public F10029 (vérifié le 01 juillet 2024) cites the same 10 years.
rules.limitations: Applicability to payroll data depends on whether the employer is a commerçant and how payroll is booked.

rules.scope: All employers: duplicate of paper payslips or payslips issued electronically
rules.trigger_text: Article does not state the start; CNIL referential counts 5 years from transmission of the payslip to the worker.
rules.guidance: Employer keeps a duplicate of payslips (or the electronic payslips) for five years.
rules.max_guidance: CNIL (Référentiel durées de conservation RH, 2026): 1 month in active base after transmission, then 5 years intermediate archive; GDPR storage limitation thereafter.
rules.verification: Read article on legifrance.gouv.fr (version en vigueur depuis le 14 mai 2009); period 'cinq ans' confirmed on page and on entreprendre.service-public.gouv.fr F10029.
rules.limitations: Start trigger not in the article text; using transmission date per CNIL.

rules.scope: Employers issuing electronic payslips: guaranteed availability to the employee
rules.trigger_text: From issue of the electronic payslip.
rules.guidance: Availability to the employee either for fifty years, or until the employee reaches the age in art. L1237-5 last paragraph plus six years (employer chooses).
rules.max_guidance: This is an availability duty towards the employee (often via a provider vault), not a licence to keep payslips in the HR system for 50 years; CNIL keeps 5 years for the employer's own archive.
rules.verification: Read article on legifrance.gouv.fr (en vigueur depuis le 01 janvier 2017).
rules.limitations: Helvetly V1 is not a payslip-vault provider; only relevant if electronic payslips are issued through it.

rules.scope: Documents for social contributions (DSN data, contribution calculations)
rules.trigger_text: Date documents were established or received.
rules.guidance: At least six years from creation/receipt (L243-16). Context: contributions are time-barred after three years from the end of the calendar year for which they are due (L244-3).
rules.max_guidance: CNIL referential: 6 years for DSN-related elements, then delete.
rules.source: Code de la sécurité sociale art. L243-16; art. L244-3 (limitation)
rules.verification: Read L244-3 (en vigueur depuis le 01 janvier 2017, view at 15 Nov 2026) and L243-16 on legifrance.gouv.fr.
rules.limitations: Longer limitation for travail dissimulé was seen only in a search snippet, not verified.

rules.scope: Books, registers, documents subject to the tax administration's audit rights (includes PAS withholding records)
rules.trigger_text: Date of last operation in the books/registers, or date documents were established.
rules.guidance: Six years from the last operation recorded in the books or from the date the documents were drawn up. Version in force until 31 Dec 2026 — see FR-RET-TAX-002.
rules.max_guidance: Superseded for documents whose period expires after 1 Jan 2027 by a 10-year period (FR-RET-TAX-002).
rules.source: Livre des procédures fiscales art. L102 B, I
rules.verification: Read current version on legifrance.gouv.fr (en vigueur depuis le 01 janvier 2023) and the future version (A venir, 01 janvier 2027).
rules.limitations: Because the 2027 rule applies to documents whose period expires after 1 Jan 2027, in practice almost every record still held today falls under 10 years.

rules.scope: Same documents as FR-RET-TAX-001, for documents whose retention period expires after 1 January 2027
rules.trigger_text: Date of last operation in the books/registers, or date documents were established.
rules.guidance: Ten years from the last operation in the books/registers or from the date documents were drawn up; applies to documents whose retention period expires after 1 Jan 2027.
rules.max_guidance: CNIL 2026 referential still cites 6 years for payroll identification data under L102 B; it predates or does not reflect this change — follow the statute.
rules.source: Livre des procédures fiscales art. L102 B, I, as amended by Loi n° 2026-534 du 25 juin 2026 art. 36
rules.verification: Read future version (A venir - Version du 01 janvier 2027) on legifrance.gouv.fr incl. transitional note: 's'appliquent aux documents et aux pièces dont le délai de conservation expire après le 1er janvier 2027'.
rules.limitations: Future provision; re-check before 2027 in case of further amendment.

rules.scope: Termination letters, solde de tout compte, certificat de travail, settlement documents
rules.trigger_text: Notification of termination (L1471-1).
rules.guidance: No dedicated retention period found. Claims on termination prescribe in twelve months from notification (L1471-1); wage claims in three years (L3245-1). Service-public lists soldes de tout compte under the 5-year row.
rules.max_guidance: CNIL: intermediate archive within the limitation period; then delete.
rules.source: Code du travail art. L1471-1 and L3245-1
rules.verification: Read L1471-1 (en vigueur depuis le 01 avril 2018) and L3245-1 (en vigueur depuis le 17 juin 2013) on legifrance.gouv.fr; these are limitation periods, not retention duties.
rules.limitations: Discrimination/harassment claims and bodily injury are excluded from L1471-1 and have longer periods (not researched).

rules.scope: Records of hours worked by each employee; on-call (astreinte) summaries; day counts for forfait-jours employees
rules.trigger_text: Article does not state a start; CNIL counts from collection.
rules.guidance: Hours worked: 1 year, or the reference period if working time is arranged over more than a year; on-call summary: 1 year; forfait-jours day counts: 3 years.
rules.max_guidance: CNIL referential notes salary claims prescribe in 3 years (L3245-1), so keeping time records up to 3 years for disputes is defensible; not longer without reason.
rules.verification: Read article on legifrance.gouv.fr (en vigueur depuis le 01 janvier 2017); 1-year and 3-year periods confirmed in page text and service-public F10029.
rules.limitations: Use 3 years where the employee is on a forfait-jours agreement.

rules.scope: Copies of titles authorising foreign workers to work
rules.trigger_text: Date the employee or intern left the establishment.
rules.guidance: A copy of each work authorisation is annexed to the registre unique du personnel (D1221-24); register entries are kept five years from the employee's departure (R1221-26).
rules.max_guidance: Delete after 5 years from departure unless a dispute is pending.
rules.source: Code du travail art. D1221-24 and R1221-26
rules.verification: Read D1221-24 (en vigueur depuis le 01 janvier 2018) and R1221-26 on legifrance.gouv.fr; R1221-26 speaks of register 'mentions', applying it to the annexed copy is an inference.
rules.limitations: Inference that the annex follows the register's 5-year period.

rules.scope: Employment contracts, amendments, termination documents
rules.trigger_text: n/a

rules.scope: All private employers.

rules.limitations: Excerpt joins the lead sentence and the list entry with '...'. Whether consent can ever justify processing beyond 328b is debated in doctrine; not researched.

rules.scope: All processing of personal data by private persons.

rules.verification: DSG (SR 235.1) Art. 6 paras 2 and 4 read on Fedlex filestore (consolidation 2025-07-07).

Church-tax status in source tax tariffs can reveal religion.

rules.scope: Justification of processing that infringes personality.
